lines.text: Eight spawns cleared in your record. Brann calls it a first deployment below the old limit. Ask how the next patrol reaches it.
You copied a page. Marshal calls it her record for a successor. Undercity's in there twice. Keep the page; keep asking about the next one.
You have the gate-cycle record. Keep the times attached. An order and the reason for it are separate records.
Your work card records the stairwell. The residents still have to use it. File the proof where they can find it.
Block Four. Objective's on the card. Bring the proof back; coffee machine's not going anywhere.
Marshal's busy. I'm not. What did you do and who saw?
Coffee machine's still working. That's the precinct report. Your work card has the rest.
